name: MaskMethod
description: Defines various methods for applying masks to paint objects.

members.name: Alpha
members.brief: Alpha masking using the masking target's pixels as an alpha value

members.name: InvAlpha
members.brief: Alpha masking using the complement to the masking target's pixels

members.name: Luma
members.brief: Alpha masking using the grayscale (0.2126R + 0.7152G + 0.0722B) of the masking target

members.name: InvLuma
members.brief: Alpha masking using the grayscale of the complement to the masking target

members.name: Add
members.brief: Combines target and source using target alpha. (T * TA) + (S * (255 - TA))

members.name: Subtract
members.brief: Subtracts source from target considering alpha. (T * TA) - (S * (255 - TA))

members.name: Intersect
members.brief: Takes minimum alpha and multiplies with target. (T * min(TA, SA))

members.name: Difference
members.brief: Absolute difference between colors. abs(T - S * (255 - TA))

members.name: Lighten
members.brief: Where masks intersect, uses the highest transparency value

members.name: Darken
members.brief: Where masks intersect, uses the lowest transparency value
